limits: Selected-level internal sampling only. Native floating packet/ISA, cube direction projection, array-layer rounding, explicit/gradient/implicit LOD and full mip/filter selection remain open.
The parent supplies admitted snapshots, selected level/filter and projected cube coordinates, pins VM/publication, and defers swizzle when further mip interpolation is required.
Cube corner construction selects one available current-face corner sample as permitted by GLES3, rather than the recommended three-sample average.

The filter is serialized and no representative texture cluster/cache throughput is qualified. Banked caches, miss joining, coherence, compiler/driver adoption and remaining H0-H8/GLES requirements remain open.
No new native software capability, instruction encoding or record field is exposed. PPA is synthesis only.
